run_kilt_ay2_main: run the main function to generate k-shot data for the KILT AidaYAGO2 dataset across multiple random seeds
create_kilt_ay2_dataset: create a Kilt_AY2 dataset instance to load and preprocess the KILT AidaYAGO2 task data
load_kilt_ay2_dataset: load the KILT AidaYAGO2 dataset from HuggingFace using the load_dataset method
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of input-output tuples with tab-separated answers
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot training, development, and test splits using the generate_k_shot_data method with a specified seed
